champion.builds: THE BEST DR. MUNDO BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Dr. Mundo Mid build, you should take Ghost and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, followed by Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, as well as Approach Velocity and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Warmog's Armor as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Heartsteel. For your last 3 items, you should build Titanic Hydra, Overlord's Bloodmail and finish with Spirit Visage. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 55.5% winrate over 573 matches played. Optional Your second option for Dr. Mundo Mid build would be to take Ghost and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Approach Velocity with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Heartsteel, which you should build first, followed by Boots of Swiftness as your second item and Warmog's Armor as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Titanic Hydra, Spirit Visage and Overlord's Bloodmail. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 54.4% win rate over 226 matches. Situational Dr. Mundo Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Dr. Mundo build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Dr. Mundo runes page.
